name: CRYSTAL RUN
brief: Something to collect, and a hill to do it on.

name: FIRST DROP
brief: Ramps, and ground that gives way.

name: RAIL RUNNER
brief: Green metal. Get on it and stay on.

name: SPEED GATES
brief: Ride the arches. They give the hill back.

name: IDOL HUNT
brief: Ten of them, and never where you already are.

name: CRYSTAL HAUL
brief: Leave nothing shining behind you.

name: IRON LINE
brief: Find the rails. Ride them properly.

name: FAST LANE
brief: Tuck low and let the hill do the work.

name: FULL PLATE
brief: A bit of everything, and no time to spare.

name: RIDGE MASTER
brief: Prove you have learned the whole ridge.

name: DOUBLE DOWN
brief: Crystals everywhere, ramps in between.

name: STEEL RUSH
brief: Rails pay, and they pay while you are on them.

name: HIGH ROLLER
brief: One number matters. Make it big.

name: SWEEP
brief: Sweep the hill, gates and all.

name: LAUNCH PARTY
brief: Every ramp you can reach, and what lies between.

name: GOLD RUSH
brief: Crystals, and the idols among them.

name: GRIND CITY
brief: Metal first, everything else after.

name: TOP SPEED
brief: Ride every gate you can reach.

name: THE GAUNTLET
brief: All three, all at once, all downhill.

name: LAST LIGHT
brief: The last run before the sun goes.

name: NIGHT SHIFT
brief: The idols are out tonight.

name: FREE FALL
brief: Let the ground do the work.

name: STONE STEP
brief: Ramp to gate, all the way down.

name: DEEP END
brief: High walls. Use them.

name: LOOSE PACK
brief: Everything on the hill is worth points.

name: SWITCH HOUSE
brief: The road never lets you settle.

name: PINCH POINT
brief: Narrow, and the gates are on the edges.

name: LONG HAUL
brief: Wide open and a long way down.

name: STEP LADDER
brief: Every drop pays if you land it.

name: STORM CHASE
brief: Idols in the bowl. Go and get them.

name: IRON WILL
brief: Rails first. Everything else after.

name: FAST CURRENT
brief: Never stop accelerating.

name: CLEAN SWEEP
brief: Leave nothing on the hill.

name: BIG NUMBERS
brief: Chain it. That is the only way.

name: NERVE PLAY
brief: Three demands, one short clock.

name: SKY LINE
brief: Ramps into gates, and nothing slower.

name: TIGHT ROPE
brief: Idols on the tightest hill there is.

name: FULL TILT
brief: Nothing held back.

name: LAST CALL
brief: Everything you have learned, at once.

name: SUNDOWN
brief: Everything the ridge has, one last time.
